mission_source.citation: P. Black, NOAA/AOML Mission Summary 990803H, Aircraft 42RF, August 3, 1999.
mission_source.review_mode: Public primary mission-summary text read through web tool. The two linked chart originals were recovered through publicly available Internet Archive captures.
mission_source.naming_evidence: The report names the separated northeastern feature Eddy Haskell and describes a single survey line through it. It distinguishes a stronger northwestern feature that was not yet completely separated.
mission_source.formation_definition_conflict: The report describes northeastern separation the preceding week; the registry initially dates Haskell in May 1999. No event equivalence or continuous identity is inferred.

charts.operator: Blended satellite sea-surface-height anomaly and current arrows, with planned survey flight lines.
charts.ssh_reference: Unspecified in the reviewed chart and mission text; distinct from the numerical diagnostic native ADT.

charts.operator: Sea-surface-temperature image with planned flight lines; not a physical eddy boundary or a vertical-temperature section.

proxy.landmark: Plotted survey waypoint 6 at the western end of the nearly horizontal IP-to-6 leg in the northeastern feature vicinity. The mission prose identifies the northeastern survey feature as Haskell.
proxy.date_qualification: Nominal altimetry chart label. The naming/flight report is August 3; the daily numerical field on August 1 is a separate product and is not the chart composite or flight observations.

diagnostic_rules.numerical_field_processing: Cloud only, one idle CPU; raw source deleted after the bounded diagnostic.
